name: ohdear.app
description:
Oh Dear watches your websites so you don't hear about downtime from your clients first. This connector puts that data, and the settings behind it, in the conversation.

Ask about what's happening right now: which monitors have issues, how much downtime a site had last month, when a certificate expires, which links are broken, whether a scheduled task failed to check in, what changed in DNS, how Lighthouse scores are trending, or what your application health checks are reporting.

Then act on it. Create and update monitors, schedule maintenance windows or start one right now before a deploy, snooze a noisy check, post an incident update to your status page, and change where alerts go at team, tag or monitor level.

Read access is always granted. Write access is opt-in, and you choose it on the consent screen along with which teams to share. You can narrow a connection to specific monitors or status pages, and revoke it at any time from Connected AI assistants in your Oh Dear account.

Requires an Oh Dear account. Connecting is one OAuth approval, with no API key to copy and paste.

Docs: https://ohdear.app/docs/tools-and-sdks/mcp-server

_published_faq.name: How do I add ohdear.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ohdear.app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ohdear.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ohdear.app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ohdear.app lists 59 MCP tools, including add_tag_group_notification_destination, add_to_broken_links_whitelist, create_cron_check, create_maintenance_period, create_monitor, create_notification_destination, create_recurring_maintenance_period, create_status_page, create_status_page_update, create_tag, create_tag_group, and delete_cron_check.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ohdear.app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ohdear.app in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
ohdear.app requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ohdear.app is developed by Oh Dear. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
